name: spec-controller-workspace
description: Workspace root for spec-controller — the reconciliation CLI and its pure core library.

scripts.lint:publint: publint --pack pnpm packages/core && publint --pack pnpm packages/spec-controller
scripts.docs:current-state: bash -o pipefail -c 'files=$(git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard) && [ -n "$files" ] || { echo "git listed no file for Vale to read" >&2; exit 1; }; git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard | xargs -0 vale'
scripts.docs:lowercase-step:
bash -o pipefail -c 'j=json; x=exits; out=$(printf "Feature: f

  @unit
  Scenario: s
    given report.$j is written
    when the run $x 2
    then the run $x 2
    and the run $x 2
    but the run $x 2
" | vale --config=.vale/steps.ini --ext=.feature --output=line); for n in 5 6 7 8 9; do grep -q "^stdin.feature:$n:[0-9]*:Steps.InterfaceMechanic:" <<< "$out" || { echo "Vale did not refuse lowercase line $n of the planted scenario" >&2; exit 1; }; done'
scripts.docs:lowercase-description:
bash -o pipefail -c 'c=SCN; r=report; line() { printf "$1 ${r}Line $2 @$c-ONE-001
"; }; plant=$(printf "Feature: f
"; line "  then" meets; printf "
  Background: b
"; line "    and" meets; printf "
  Rule: r
"; line "    but" meets; printf "
  @unit
  Scenario: s
"; for w in given when then and but; do line "    $w" "is tagged"; done; line "    whenever" meets); for gate in ".vale/descriptions.ini Descriptions.CodeIdentifier" ".vale.ini Identifiers.ClaimCode"; do set -- $gate; out=$(vale --config=$1 --ext=.feature --output=line <<< "$plant"); for n in 2 5 8 17; do grep -q "^stdin.feature:$n:[0-9]*:$2:" <<< "$out" || { echo "Vale did not refuse control line $n under $2" >&2; exit 1; }; done; for n in 12 13 14 15 16; do ! grep -q "^stdin.feature:$n:[0-9]*:$2:" <<< "$out" || { echo "$2 refused lowercase line $n of the planted scenario" >&2; exit 1; }; done; done'
scripts.docs:references: bash -o pipefail -c 'git ls-files -z -- "*.md" "features/*.feature" | xargs -0 remark --no-config --no-stdout --frail --quiet --use ./scripts/remark-feature-prose.mjs --use remark-validate-links'

notChecks: ci.yml:ci:Read the Python Semgrep runs on
ci.yml:ci:Hand the built packages to the release
